To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance prediction of a parallel program on a shared memory multiprocessor is a complex task and requires the use of a number of tools.
the performance of parallel scientific programs can be predicted reasonably well by an interactive tool that is built around a simple analytical model.

we have built an interactive tool that can be used to predict performance of parallel programs, and we have proposed an analytical model that can be used for performance prediction of programs with data references in hierarchical systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a performance prediction system for parallel programs and the application of the system to the analysis of the performance degradation due to the data references in a hierarchical memory system.
the design and implementation of a performance prediction tool for parallel programs.
building a tool which is useful in analyzing and predicting performance of parallel programs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have a system that works well for the types of problems it was intended to handle.
the system is still under development.
the model is a reasonable first approximation to the real behavior, but more research is required before the model is useful.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the system provides a convenient environment for interactive analysis of programs and performance prediction.
we are developing a tool that can predict the execution time of parallel programs on a hierarchical memory multiprocessor system.
we have developed a tool which is easy to use, and provides reasonably good estimates of execution times.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the performance prediction of parallel scientific programs is a complex problem and that a simple analytical model can be used as a tool in the interactive environment to help the user in understanding the performance of his/her program.
, with the use of a good interactive environment, the user can easily obtain performance estimates of programs and can use the estimates as a guideline to improve the performance.
, by building analytical models into a tool, we have been able to predict the performance of programs with a reasonable degree of accuracy.
